name: Parachute
description: Conservative survival strategy. On wins: reset and lock gains. On losing streaks: switch to high win-chance mode to tread water, then reset cleanly.

bankroll_rules.daily_stop_loss: 20x base bet remaining — stop for the day

conditions.note: Fires first on every win — immediately kills any inflated bet and locks the small recovery.
Soft martingale — only 40% steps instead of 100%, so the bankroll dies much slower.
The parachute — after 4 consecutive losses, switches to 72% win chance. You win 3 out of 4 bets at low payout, surviving instead of bleeding.
After clawing back 4 wins in survival mode, resets win chance back to the base 49%.
Paired with condition 4 — also resets the bet amount to base on the same 4-win recovery.
Hard floor — if losses go 15 deep without recovery, stops the bot entirely so you don't lose everything overnight.
